json.error: Scheduled tasks cannot be shown because this server's cron service is not installed, and no scheduled task runs until it is. The server owner installs it once: in CelikPanel open Components and install "Scheduled tasks (cron)", or on the server run sudo apt-get install cron (Debian/Ubuntu), or sudo pacman -S cronie and then sudo systemctl enable --now cronie (Arch). Then open this page again.
